item.title: Viewpoints: Faith, Service and Building Homes
item.description: As clergy serving faith communities in Orange County, we find ourselves now in an awkward position. For many years our churches have been enthusiastic supporters of Habitat for Humanity, but as faith leaders we cannot support Habitat’s current plans for a new housing development in Hillsborough.
